title: feat: Complete Phase 11-13 L2/L3 features (Grid, Record Detail, Kanban)
body:
Implements all remaining L2 (Production) and L3 (Excellence) features for Phases 11–13 of the console roadmap, bringing Grid, Record Detail, and Kanban to full completion.

### Phase 11: Grid & Table Excellence → L3 Complete

- **`useCellClipboard`** — Multi-cell range selection, Ctrl+C/V with Excel-compatible tab-separated format
- **`useGradientColor`** — Maps numeric field values to Tailwind gradient classes with configurable color stops
- **`useGroupReorder`** — Drag-and-drop group section reordering (HTML5 DnD)
- **`FormulaBar`** — f(x) editor bar with Enter/Escape confirm/cancel
- **`SplitPaneGrid`** — Resizable divider between frozen and scrollable column areas
- **`useGroupedData`** updated — Aggregation support (`sum`/`count`/`avg`/`min`/`max` per group via `AggregationConfig[]`)

### Phase 12: Record Detail & Navigation → L3 Complete

- **`InlineCreateRelated`** — Tabbed Create/Link UI for related records
- **`RichTextCommentInput`** — Markdown toolbar, @mention autocomplete, preview toggle
- **`DiffView`** — Unified/side-by-side field change diff (string, number, boolean, JSON, date)
- **`RecordNavigationEnhanced`** — First/Last + search-while-navigating + Home/End shortcuts
- **`RelationshipGraph`** — SVG node-link graph with multi-level concentric layout
- **`CommentAttachment`** — Drag-and-drop file upload with image thumbnails
- **`PointInTimeRestore`** — Revision timeline with snapshot preview and two-step restore

### Phase 13: Kanban & Views Enhancement → L3 Complete

- **`InlineQuickAdd`** — Multi-field inline form (no dialog), Enter/Escape, template default values
- **`CardTemplates`** — Dropdown template selector pre-filling `InlineQuickAdd`
- **`useColumnWidths`** — Per-column width overrides with min/max clamping and localStorage persistence
- **`useCrossSwimlaneMove`** — Cross-swimlane card movement with `acceptFrom` constraint validation
- **`useQuickAddReorder`** — Drag-to-reorder cards within columns

### Tests

85 new tests (29 grid + 32 detail + 24 kanban). Full suite: 4563 tests pass across 263 files, 0 failures.

### Roadmap

`ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` updated: Phases 11–13 marked L3 Complete across header, phase sections, feature tables, timeline, and success metrics.
